about: Choices made on the copy of sanskritdocuments.org's text, each read on the owner's Gita Press scan; reconciliation.md gives every one with its reason. Keys: <chapter ref>#<seq in the copy>.

6.8#35.why: the copy's variant reading "(स भक्त्या)" left out (PLAYBOOK §2: fix, don't annotate)

v: दत्त्वैवमतुलां शक्तिं ब्रह्मणे सा शिवा मुने ।
3.3#28.why: a stray backtick (`) after the daṇḍa

v: बालश्च भोजनं नैच्छत्तदा तत्र ययौ प्रसूः
4.17#26.why: बहुश; → बहुशः: a semicolon typed for the visarga

v: एवं यन्त्रं समालिख्य प्रणवे नव वेष्टयेत् ।
6.14#18.why: "त-व" after the daṇḍa is an editor's mark of the copy, not text; प्रणवे नव as printed, the reading of wisdomlib.org 6.14.18 too

v: धिग् जन्म तव दक्षाद्य महामूढोऽसि पापधीः
2.2.34#22.why: the copy: धिक् जन्म … पापधीःस्; the book (scan p. 460): धिग् जन्म … पापधीः — a stray स् and the unassimilated धिक्

6.13#29.why: मयोत्पन्नं → मायोत्पन्नं: a dropped ा; the Kalyan Hindi reads "ये पाँचों मायासे उत्पन्न हैं" (॥ २४-२८ ॥, scan p. 406), and the next verse speaks of Māyā as their source; the metre is the same

3.6#1.why: the copy's heading अथ नन्दीश्वरावतारमाह left out: the book begins the adhyāya with the speaker (Kalyan scan p. 72: "सनत्कुमार बोले—")

v: सनत्कुमार सर्वज्ञ शृणु त्वं भैरवीं कथाम् ।
3.8#1.why: the copy's heading अथ भैरवावतारमाह left out: the book begins the adhyāya with the speaker (Kalyan scan p. 77: "नन्दीश्वर बोले—")

6.1#1.why: a heading of the copy (अथ षष्ठी कैलाससंहिता प्रारभ्यते), not a verse

3.1#51.why: the copy leaves the chapter's last verse unnumbered; the Kalyan Hindi numbers it ॥ ५० ॥ (scan p. 65)

v: (११) स यश्चायं पुरुषे यश्चासावादित्ये स एकः
(१९) सर्वोऽहं सर्वात्मकोऽहं संसारी यद्भूतं यच्च भव्यं यद्वर्तमानं सर्वात्मकत्वादद्वितीयोऽहम्
6.19#1.why: the list of mahāvākyas before verse 1, numbered within the list and not as verses, as the Kalyan scan prints it (p. 421: 'सुब्रह्मण्य बोले — अब महावाक्योंको कहता हूँ — १-प्रज्ञानं ब्रह्म …'); the copy's quotation marks around अथ महावाक्यानि left out

2.5.49#1.why: Śukra's prose namaskāra (ॐ नमस्ते देवेशाय …) before verse 1, without a number

4.10#32.why: the copy prints ॥ ३॥ between 31 and 33: a dropped digit

4.12#12.why: the copy prints ॥ १॥ between 11 and 13: a dropped digit

1.1#1.why: the book prints the opening maṅgala-śloka (आद्यन्तमङ्गल…) without a number; the copy numbers it 1 with the first verse (scan p. 45)

3.1#1.why: the opening maṅgala-śloka (वन्दे महानन्द…), unnumbered as at 1.1; the copy numbers it 1 with the first verse

5.49#19.why: the copy drops verse 20 (19 is followed by 21); the Kalyan Hindi has it (॥ १९-२० ॥: 'जिसका ऐसा चरित्र है, मुझे उसीके शरणमें जाना चाहिये', scan p. 371); the text from wisdomlib.org's Shiva Purana [sanskrit] 9.49.20, which follows the Gita Press numbering

6.14#19.why: the copy drops verse 20 (19 is followed by 21); the Kalyan Hindi has it (॥ १९-२० ॥, scan p. 410); the text from wisdomlib.org's Shiva Purana [sanskrit] 6.14.20 (the owner's screenshot), पंच written पञ्च by the standard

speaker_lines.about: a speaker's line as the book prints it: no daṇḍa or dash after it; typing slips in the copy (उवाच्, नारद्, सन्त्कुमार, ऋष्य, दक्षवाच, उचुः for ऊचुः, a visarga kept before a vowel against sandhi: मुनयः ऊचुः → मुनय ऊचुः); 2.2.1: the chapter's title (सतीसङ्क्षेपचरित्रवर्णनं) run into the line
